name.title: DP_AVS_ECE_REGISTERS
name.sysdesc:
Contains a snapshot of all the ECE registers for all the boards except the BDS.
Created during FSW initialization and upon command

field.sysdesc: 0x000c, Invalid PCI Access Address Register (IPCIA), readback 0xC0DE02BE
0x0050, EDAC Error Address for BC RAM
0x6014: SSIRU EDAC Most Recent SBE Addr, Last DBE Addr
